title: HelperSSHSignResult
description: The signature, in the wire encoding of an ssh signature (a string format followed by a string blob, RFC 4253 §6.6) — the form x/crypto/ssh's own Unmarshal reads back into a Signature, which is how the helper hands it to the library unchanged. The encoding is the library's and not ours on purpose: a bespoke struct here would be a second decoder for a value the library already knows how to read.
